name: navi
description: NAVI Friend System — local-first AI friend that watches your shared screen and chats with you

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && esbuild electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/electron/preload.js --log-level=warning && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist-electron/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json && node e2e/run.cjs
scripts.eval:character: tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && esbuild scripts/eval-character.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/scripts/eval-character.cjs --log-level=warning && node dist-electron/scripts/eval-character.cjs
